theme: A dry-land day in Dubrovnik before the boat.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — nothing between you and Dubrovnik. What matters is the short list of things that can only be done from shore before Saturday's charter.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers from shore
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 hotel is booked, but the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, an afternoon bag hold, and a 5:15 AM Sept 20 checkout for the 7:30 flight all need arranging now — the charter has almost no signal once you board.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the charter boarding
needsAttention.detail: Reach the Nautilus instructor while you are still on land to pin down Saturday's boarding time and place, and the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 to Oct 5 car
needsAttention.detail: This is no longer a hedge. Book the Full Size SUV at TPA outright for the landing and the Orlando run — a walk-up rate jet-lagged on a Sunday is the alternative.

needsAttention.title: Send Kerrie the AI paper
needsAttention.detail: Kerrie Waring wrote back asking for the AI governance paper you mentioned. Worth answering before you lose signal for the week.

flagged.title: Valoris call still pending
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano flagged that you two still need a call about the Nomura/NRI project; no time is set yet.

inbox.noise: The rest is booking receipts, Airbnb confirmations, and the daily language newsletters.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell will reconnect after the 19th
resolved.detail: Carol closed the loop — 'Happy sailing! Let's talk when you are back' — so the intro call moves to after your return.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first chestnuts and winter squash to market, both at their sweetest now.

tasks.title: Close the St Pete landing-gap lodging

acts.line: A clear morning in the Old Port apartment, with no meetings on the calendar anywhere in the Dubrovnik stay.
The dry-land list comes due: transfers, the early checkout, and the charter instructor, all before Saturday.
One of the last quiet evenings ashore before a week at sea on the Nautilus.
